description:
Perform a supply chain network analysis to visualize delivery routes.

1. Open QGIS (it should already be running).
2. Load the warehouse layer from /home/ga/GIS_Data/logistics/warehouses.geojson and the store layer from /home/ga/GIS_Data/logistics/retail_stores.geojson.
3. Open the Processing Toolbox (Processing > Toolbox) and find the tool 'Distance to nearest hub (line to hub)'.
4. Run the tool with:
   - Source points layer: retail_stores
   - Destination hubs layer: warehouses
   - Hub layer name attribute: 'name'
   - Measurement units: Meters
5. The output will be a temporary layer of lines connecting each store to its closest warehouse.
6. Export this line layer to a file: Right-click the output layer > Export > Save Features As > Format: GeoJSON > File name: /home/ga/GIS_Data/exports/hub_connections.geojson.
